description: Taxonomie fermée Kairos v1.0 — 10 catégories, ~75 sous-types. Chaque event C2 doit porter un cat_id et subtype_id issus de cette liste. Source de vérité du moteur C4.

categories.description: Décisions et communications des banques centrales affectant taux, liquidité et conditions financières.

subtypes.label: Rate Decision — Hike
subtypes.description: Central bank raises policy rate (planned or surprise)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: If QT already in progress, intensity_credit may be amplified

subtypes.label: Rate Decision — Cut
subtypes.description: Central bank lowers policy rate

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: If cutting into inflation, gold may diverge bullish

subtypes.label: Rate Decision — Hold
subtypes.description: Central bank keeps policy rate unchanged; market focus on forward guidance tone

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Pure hold has minimal impact; dominant signal is the statement tone

subtypes.label: Forward Guidance — Hawkish
subtypes.description: CB signals higher-for-longer or future tightening without immediate action

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Signal strength depends on market positioning; surprise factor amplifies

subtypes.label: Forward Guidance — Dovish
subtypes.description: CB signals rate cuts ahead or more accommodative stance
examples: ECB opens door to cuts Mar 2024

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: If dovish pivot occurs amid high inflation, equities may rally but bonds less

subtypes.label: QE Announcement
subtypes.description: Central bank announces new asset purchase programme (quantitative easing)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Diminishing returns on successive QE rounds; currency wars risk in multi-CB context

subtypes.label: QT Announcement
subtypes.description: Central bank announces balance sheet reduction (quantitative tightening)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Pace matters: $60bn vs $95bn/month has very different transmission speed

subtypes.label: Tapering
subtypes.description: Gradual reduction of existing QE pace before full stop

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Taper tantrum risk if unexpected; well-telegraphed tapers have limited impact

subtypes.label: Emergency Action — Easing
subtypes.description: Unscheduled CB intervention: emergency rate cut, liquidity facility, FX intervention

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Emergency actions signal CB sees a crisis; may paradoxically increase fear short-term

subtypes.label: Emergency Action — Tightening
subtypes.description: Unscheduled CB intervention: emergency hike or FX intervention to defend currency

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: May signal currency stress; sovereign spread reaction depends on credibility

categories.description: Publications statistiques officielles sur l'activité économique, l'emploi, les prix et le commerce.

subtypes.label: CPI — Above Expectations
subtypes.description: Published CPI materially exceeds consensus (+0.1pp or more)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: If driven by energy alone, core inflation may diverge; central bank response varies

subtypes.label: CPI — Below Expectations
subtypes.description: Published CPI materially misses consensus (-0.1pp or more)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Deflation risk context changes asset reaction: equities may sell if deflationary spiral feared

subtypes.label: CPI — In Line with Expectations
subtypes.description: Published CPI within ±0.05pp of consensus

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Minimal price action; markets move on core vs headline divergence

subtypes.label: GDP — Above Expectations
subtypes.description: GDP print materially beats consensus

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Strong GDP raises rate expectations; may be net negative for equities in inflation context

subtypes.label: GDP — Below Expectations
subtypes.description: GDP print materially misses consensus or negative

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Recession + high inflation = stagflation; bonds may also sell

subtypes.label: GDP Revision — Upward
subtypes.description: Revision of prior GDP estimate upward
examples: BEA Q2 2023 GDP revised to 2.4% from 2.0%

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Revisions rarely move markets unless magnitude is large

subtypes.label: GDP Revision — Downward
subtypes.description: Revision of prior GDP estimate downward
examples: UK GDP revised to -0.5% confirming recession

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Downward revisions confirming recession fears more impactful

subtypes.label: NFP — Above Expectations
subtypes.description: US Non-Farm Payrolls beat consensus

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Strong jobs in soft-landing scenario bullish equities; in inflation scenario bearish

subtypes.label: NFP — Below Expectations
subtypes.description: US Non-Farm Payrolls miss consensus

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Weak jobs + high inflation = stagflation risk

subtypes.label: Unemployment — Rising
subtypes.description: Unemployment rate increases above consensus or trend
examples: US unemployment 4.3% Jul 2024 Sahm rule trigger

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Sahm Rule crossing 0.5% signals recession with high historical accuracy

subtypes.label: Unemployment — Falling
subtypes.description: Unemployment rate decreases below consensus or multi-year low

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Tight labor market signals wage pressure → inflation risk

subtypes.label: PMI — Expansion
subtypes.description: PMI (composite/manufacturing/services) above 50 and/or beats consensus

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Leading indicator; actual GDP print may diverge

subtypes.label: PMI — Contraction
subtypes.description: PMI below 50 and/or misses consensus materially

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Manufacturing vs Services divergence is key; services PMI more predictive in modern economy

subtypes.label: Trade Balance — Deficit Widening
subtypes.description: Trade deficit widens significantly beyond expectations

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Trade deficit can be positive (strong domestic demand) or negative (structural weakness)

subtypes.label: Consumer Confidence — Rising
subtypes.description: Consumer confidence index beats consensus significantly

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Soft data; actual retail sales print is more actionable

subtypes.label: Consumer Confidence — Falling
subtypes.description: Consumer confidence index misses consensus significantly or multi-year low

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: University of Michigan vs Conference Board have different leading properties

subtypes.label: Retail Sales — Above Expectations
subtypes.description: Retail sales beat consensus, signalling robust consumer spending
examples: US Retail Sales +1.3% MoM vs +0.3% est Dec 2023

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Control group retail sales (ex-auto, gas, food) most predictive for GDP

subtypes.label: Retail Sales — Below Expectations
subtypes.description: Retail sales miss consensus, signalling consumer spending weakness

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: One-month miss often weather/seasonal; trend over 3m more meaningful

categories.description: Conflits armés, sanctions, crises diplomatiques et changements de régime.

subtypes.label: Armed Conflict — Start
subtypes.description: New armed conflict begins between nations or major intra-national war

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: UST safe haven bid competes with inflation/fiscal fear; depends on US involvement

subtypes.label: Armed Conflict — Escalation
subtypes.description: Existing conflict escalates materially (new front, nuclear threat, NATO involvement)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Escalation effects diminish with market fatigue; first event most impactful

subtypes.label: Armed Conflict — Ceasefire
subtypes.description: Ceasefire agreement or major de-escalation in ongoing conflict

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Credibility of ceasefire key; fragile truces have limited lasting market impact

subtypes.label: Sanctions — New Package Announced
subtypes.description: Major sanctions package announced against a country or entity

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Secondary sanctions and implementation speed determine market impact magnitude

subtypes.label: Sanctions — Lifted or Eased
subtypes.description: Significant lifting or easing of existing sanctions

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Oil supply addition from sanctions lifting depends on target country capacity

subtypes.label: Diplomatic Crisis
subtypes.description: Major diplomatic breakdown without direct military action

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Diplomatic crises rarely move markets substantially unless escalation risk is high

subtypes.label: Regime Change — Destabilizing
subtypes.description: Government overthrow, coup, or election producing political instability

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: EM contagion depends on country size and financial linkages

subtypes.label: Regime Change — Stabilizing
subtypes.description: Peaceful transition or election producing stable pro-market government

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Market reaction depends on pre-existing risk premium compression

subtypes.label: Major Terrorism Event
subtypes.description: High-casualty terrorist attack on civilian or infrastructure targets

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Recovery typically fast (days); 9/11 exception due to systemic disruption scale

categories.description: Décisions OPEC+, disruptions d'approvisionnement, chocs agricoles et déficits en matières premières.

subtypes.label: OPEC+ Production Cut
subtypes.description: OPEC+ announces meaningful production reduction

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Compliance rate and global demand outlook modulate magnitude of oil price move

subtypes.label: OPEC+ Production Increase
subtypes.description: OPEC+ announces production quota increase or restoration

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Demand destruction context may limit price relief effect

subtypes.label: Oil Supply Disruption
subtypes.description: Major unplanned supply disruption (attack, natural disaster, embargo)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: SPR releases can offset short-term; duration depends on reserve buffer vs outage

subtypes.label: Oil Demand Revision — Upward
subtypes.description: IEA/OPEC/EIA revises global oil demand upward significantly

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Agency revisions are lagging; market often already priced move

subtypes.label: Oil Demand Revision — Downward
subtypes.description: IEA/OPEC/EIA revises global oil demand downward (recession, EV adoption)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Long-term EV transition demand destruction = structural not cyclical

subtypes.label: Natural Gas Supply Disruption
subtypes.description: Major gas supply outage or infrastructure damage

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: European economy particularly sensitive; industrial curtailment = GDP drag

subtypes.label: Gas Storage — Critical Alert
subtypes.description: Gas storage falls to critically low levels or policy emergency declared

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: EU 80% refill target is market anchor

subtypes.label: Agricultural — Major Drought
subtypes.description: Significant drought impacting major crop producing region

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Food inflation particularly impactful in EM where food weight in CPI is higher

subtypes.label: Agricultural — Surplus / Bumper Harvest
subtypes.description: Major crop surplus or bumper harvest reducing food prices

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Disinflation from food prices modest in DM where food weight is low

subtypes.label: Critical Metals — Shortage
subtypes.description: Significant shortage of industrial or critical metals

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Critical minerals shortage increasingly geopolitical — China export controls risk

subtypes.label: Critical Metals — Surplus
subtypes.description: Oversupply of industrial metals depressing prices

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Chinese demand signal is primary driver of metals surplus/deficit cycle

categories.description: Tarifs douaniers, accords commerciaux, restrictions à l'export et tensions commerciales.

subtypes.label: Tariff — New or Increased
subtypes.description: New tariff or significant tariff increase imposed on goods

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Retaliation risk amplifies impact; affected sectors (autos, agri, tech) diverge

subtypes.label: Tariff — Cut or Removal
subtypes.description: Tariff reduction or removal as part of trade deal or unilateral easing

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Impact depends on magnitude and strategic significance of goods targeted

subtypes.label: Tariff — Threat or Warning
subtypes.description: Official tariff threat without implementation

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Markets increasingly desensitized to repeated threats

subtypes.label: Trade Agreement — Signed
subtypes.description: Major free trade agreement signed or enters into force

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Markets often price in deal before signing; announcement effect may be limited

subtypes.label: Trade Agreement — Collapsed
subtypes.description: Major trade deal falls apart or withdrawal announced

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Uncertainty premium added; renegotiation risk vs clean break

subtypes.label: Export Restriction — Technology
subtypes.description: Export controls on technology (semiconductors, AI chips, software)
examples: US chip export ban to China Oct 2022

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Long-term supply chain restructuring impact dominates short-term

subtypes.label: Export Restriction — Commodity
subtypes.description: Export ban or restriction on agricultural or raw material commodities

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Particularly inflationary for food-importing EM countries

subtypes.label: Currency Manipulation — Accusation
subtypes.description: Major country accused of currency manipulation by Treasury or trading partner
examples: US labels China currency manipulator Aug 2019

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Accusation rarely leads to formal action; political signaling dominates

subtypes.label: Trade War — Escalation
subtypes.description: Tit-for-tat tariff/trade retaliation cycle escalating

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Global supply chain disruption adds persistence to impact

subtypes.label: Trade War — De-escalation
subtypes.description: Trade war truce, phase deal, or tariff rollback reducing tensions

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Partial deals may boost sentiment without fundamentally resolving tensions

categories.description: Politiques fiscales, dépenses publiques, réglementation financière et notations souveraines.

subtypes.label: Fiscal Stimulus — Major
subtypes.description: Large-scale government spending package (>1% GDP)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Multiplier depends on output gap; stimulus in full employment = inflation not growth

subtypes.label: Fiscal Stimulus — Minor
subtypes.description: Targeted government spending or tax credit (<1% GDP)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Narrow impact; sector-specific rather than macro

subtypes.label: Fiscal Austerity
subtypes.description: Major government spending cuts or fiscal consolidation programme

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Expansionary austerity theory empirically weak; typically contractionary short-term

subtypes.label: Corporate Tax Hike
subtypes.description: Announced increase in corporate tax rate

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Market impact front-runs effective date; actual vs proposed rate matters

subtypes.label: Corporate Tax Cut
subtypes.description: Announced decrease in corporate tax rate

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Buyback activity surge often first market signal of corporate tax cuts

subtypes.label: Consumer Tax Hike
subtypes.description: VAT, income tax, or sales tax increase hitting consumer purchasing power

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Japan VAT hikes historically triggered mini-recessions

subtypes.label: Financial Regulation — Tightening
subtypes.description: New banking regulation increasing capital requirements or compliance burden

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Long implementation timelines; financial stocks react to announcement

subtypes.label: Financial Regulation — Easing
subtypes.description: Rollback of financial regulation reducing compliance burden

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Moral hazard risk; short-term positive for banks, long-term systemic risk increase

subtypes.label: Sovereign Credit Downgrade
subtypes.description: Rating agency downgrades sovereign credit rating

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: US downgrade paradoxically can trigger UST rally (safe haven demand)

subtypes.label: Sovereign Credit Upgrade
subtypes.description: Rating agency upgrades sovereign credit rating

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Often partially priced in; surprise upgrades have more impact

subtypes.label: Debt Ceiling Crisis
subtypes.description: Government hits debt ceiling with risk of technical default

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: T-bills near X-date trade at big discount; resolution produces sharp V-shaped reversal

categories.description: Défaillances bancaires, événements de crédit, crashs de marché et risques systémiques.

subtypes.label: Bank Failure
subtypes.description: A bank fails or is seized by regulators

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Contagion speed amplified by social media bank run dynamics (SVB 2023)

subtypes.label: Bank Rescue / Bailout
subtypes.description: Government or CB intervenes to rescue a failing institution

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Rescue credibility depends on firepower; equity shareholders typically wiped out

subtypes.label: Credit Event — Sovereign Default
subtypes.description: Sovereign default, restructuring, or missed payment

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Orderly restructuring vs disorderly default has very different contagion dynamics

subtypes.label: Credit Event — Corporate Default
subtypes.description: Major corporate default, bankruptcy, or restructuring

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Sector contagion model matters: real estate vs crypto vs finance

subtypes.label: Market Crash
subtypes.description: Sudden large equity or multi-asset selloff (>5% in a day)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Circuit breakers may pause market; Fed put probability high in severe crashes

subtypes.label: Flash Crash
subtypes.description: Sudden extreme intraday market move reversed quickly, often algo-driven

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Flash crashes typically fully reverse; persistent fear signal if partial recovery only

subtypes.label: Contagion — Spread Widening
subtypes.description: Credit or sovereign spread contagion spreading across countries or asset classes

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Draghi 'whatever it takes' showed CB can arrest contagion

subtypes.label: Systemic Risk Warning
subtypes.description: Official systemic risk warning from FSB, BIS, IMF, or major CB

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Official warnings often lagging; BIS early warnings more prescient

subtypes.label: Liquidity Crisis
subtypes.description: Acute market or banking liquidity shortage (repo stress, dollar shortage)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Fed/ECB/BoE backstop credibility determines duration; swap lines resolve dollar shortage

categories.description: Blocages logistiques, pénuries de composants et chocs d'approvisionnement.

subtypes.label: Port Blockage
subtypes.description: Major port or shipping lane blocked or severely disrupted

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Suez blockage added ~$200bn/week in supply chain delays

subtypes.label: Shipping Disruption
subtypes.description: Major disruption to global shipping routes (Red Sea attacks, Panama Canal drought)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Drewry composite freight index is primary real-time indicator

subtypes.label: Major Factory Shutdown
subtypes.description: Key factory or industrial complex forced to shut down

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: TSMC concentration risk = potential single-point failure for global semiconductor supply

subtypes.label: Semiconductor Shortage
subtypes.description: Widespread chip shortage affecting multiple industries

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Lead times 12-18m in automotive; capex super-cycle creates future oversupply risk

subtypes.label: Critical Material Shortage
subtypes.description: Shortage of rare earth, critical minerals, or strategic inputs

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Energy transition creates structural demand for Li, Co, Ni, rare earths through 2040+

subtypes.label: Logistics Bottleneck
subtypes.description: General logistics system stress (trucking, rail, warehouse)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: PMI supply delivery times is best aggregate proxy

subtypes.label: Pandemic / Mass Disease Supply Shock
subtypes.description: Pandemic-level disruption to production and logistics

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: CB/fiscal response determines post-shock inflation trajectory

categories.description: Événements climatiques extrêmes, catastrophes naturelles et politiques de transition énergétique.

subtypes.label: Major Drought
subtypes.description: Severe drought impacting agriculture, energy (hydro), or water supply at national scale

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Rhine low water impacted German industrial output directly in 2022

subtypes.label: Major Flood
subtypes.description: Catastrophic flooding causing significant economic damage

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Reconstruction spending partially offsets GDP drag

subtypes.label: Hurricane / Major Typhoon
subtypes.description: Category 3-5 hurricane or typhoon causing major economic damage

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Katrina hit Gulf oil infrastructure; 2022 hurricanes impacted Florida insurance market

subtypes.label: Major Earthquake / Tsunami
subtypes.description: Magnitude 7+ earthquake or tsunami with major economic impact

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Japan repatriated yen post-Fukushima → JPY strength despite disaster

subtypes.label: Major Wildfire
subtypes.description: Catastrophic wildfire season causing economic damage

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: PG&E bankruptcy from California wildfires shows utility sector tail risk

subtypes.label: Major Climate Policy Announced
subtypes.description: New climate law or international agreement with significant economic implications

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: IRA $369bn triggered massive capex reallocation to US green manufacturing

subtypes.label: Carbon Tax / ETS Announced
subtypes.description: New carbon tax or major ETS price change

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Carbon border adjustment (CBAM) creates new trade policy dimension

subtypes.label: Green Deal / ESG Regulation
subtypes.description: Major ESG or sustainability regulation (CSRD, taxonomy, SFDR)

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Compliance costs vs capital reallocation; long lag to economic impact

subtypes.label: Energy Transition Target Announced
subtypes.description: Major renewable energy capacity target or fossil phase-out deadline

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Target credibility depends on policy mechanism; EU has binding targets

categories.description: Ruptures technologiques, actions antitrust, cyberattaques et changements démographiques.

subtypes.label: Major AI Breakthrough
subtypes.description: Major AI capability announcement with significant economic implications

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Productivity shock potential: general purpose technology multiplier ~5-10x direct effect

subtypes.label: Tech Antitrust Action
subtypes.description: Major antitrust lawsuit, fine, or breakup order against tech company

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: EU DMA/DSA more impactful than US antitrust due to faster enforcement

subtypes.label: Technology Export Ban
subtypes.description: Strategic technology export ban affecting chip, software, or dual-use tech
examples: US CHIPS Act + export controls Oct 2022
EDA tool export ban to China

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: NVIDIA H100/H800 controls most impactful for AI supply chain globally

subtypes.label: Positive Productivity Shock
subtypes.description: Technological breakthrough creating measurable productivity gains

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Productivity shocks have long lags; market prices future earnings

subtypes.label: Cyber Attack — Critical Infrastructure
subtypes.description: Major cyber attack on power grid, water, transport, or government systems

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Colonial Pipeline: +30% east coast fuel prices in days

subtypes.label: Cyber Attack — Financial System
subtypes.description: Major cyber attack on financial institutions, exchanges, or payment systems

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Payment system disruption most systemic; SWIFT alternatives reduce concentration risk

subtypes.label: Demographic Structural Shift
subtypes.description: Major demographic change announcement with long-term economic implications

drivers_mapping.conflict_note: Ultra-long horizon (decades); markets price via yield curve shape
